title: Resource
description: The identity of the emitting process (section 5.2 of PR-001). One field per concept. The identity of a process, of an actor, of an execution and of a correlation are separate concepts (REQ-CTR-005).

service_name.description: Logical name of the application or service.

instance_id.description: Identifier of this running instance (process or pod). Generated at start if the consumer does not give it.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the source (for example Europe/Madrid). It is only for display and is never used to compute a time (ADR-012).
